alex_sales: Quick sales-to-CS handoff for Willow.ai pilot — signed 3mo midmarket pilot yesterday. Primary contact: Priya Kumar <priya@willow.ai>. Key asks: private eval (VPC), SAML SSO, ability to upload private embeddings, and light observability. Estimated usage: 5-10 QPS peak, ~50k tokens/day. Pilot ends 2026-06-15; they want a success review 2 weeks prior. Assigning @maya_cs to own onboarding and @lin_eng for private eval. Can someone confirm capacity options and an expected timeline? :wave:
maya_cs: Thanks Alex — I can own this. I'll set up kickoff and run the enablement. Need: SSO metadata, sample API usage patterns (prompts, avg seq len), and decision on whether they want Dedicated capacity or Private on-prem eval. I'll propose a timeline: discovery + SSO config (3 business days), private eval spin-up (5-7 business days), enablement session (1 day). Can Priya do next-week Wed for kickoff? :calendar:
lin_eng: Got it. For private eval we need their target region, VPC peering details (CIDR), and whether they'll bring their own HSM/KMS. Typical spin-up for a small private cluster is ~4 business days if we have SAML metadata and SSH/KMS access; 7 if we need on-prem hardware prep. Also: which model family? If they plan to test larger context lengths we'll need to size nodes accordingly. We should also confirm expected concurrency patterns (burst vs steady). :eyes:
dan_support: I'll draft an on-call/runbook template for Willow.ai and prep support channels. Recommend a dedicated support tag and add them to the private-evals rotation for the pilot. Also suggest creating a PagerDuty schedule entry for the pilot window and a short escalation matrix. I can reuse the Montara private-eval runbook and tailor it. :+1:
jen_ops: From finance/ops side: confirm contracted seats and billing cadence before we spin up Dedicated. Also check if they signed the private-deploy addendum (security/compliance). Alex — can you upload the executed SOW or PV?
alex_sales: Uploading SOW now: https://redwood.internal/docs/agreements/willow-sow-1938 (internal link). They verified security addendum but asked to keep data in EU region. Priya confirmed model family: 'gpt-4o-redwood' variants with 8k context for initial tests. They expect encryption-at-rest via customer KMS. Priya ok for Wed kickoff at 10am PT.
lin_eng: EU region constraint noted. For KMS we need key ARN and IAM principal for access; if they want HSM we'll need lead time. Small checklist I'm missing: (1) SAML metadata, (2) VPC CIDR + peering contact, (3) KMS ARN + IAM principal, (4) sample payloads/avg token lengths. If Alex can share sample traffic profile I'll put together a sizing + timeline doc. Example SAML snippet we typically ask for (paste in slack as file if possible):
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.willow.ai">
  <IDPSSODescriptor>
    <!-- metadata ... -->
  </IDPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
maya_cs: I'll collect the sample prompts and a short success criteria doc (conversion metrics, latency targets, accuracy eval). Actions I'm taking: (A) schedule kickoff invite for Wed 10am PT with Priya, Lin, Dan, Jen, Alex, and myself; (B) create CS onboarding checklist and share; (C) capture success metrics and reporting cadence. I'll send the checklist today. :rocket:
dan_support: Once we have the checklist I'll draft the runbook and add smoke tests: auth flow, sample generation, embedding upload, and latency checks. Also recommend enabling trace-level logging for first 72 hours.
alex_sales: I've asked Priya to share SAML metadata + KMS ARN + VPC contact by EOD today. She confirmed they'll provide a small sample dataset for embedding upload (anonymized).
deploy-bot: private-eval request created -> REF# PE-2026-47; owner: lin_eng; target region: eu-west-1; ETA: pending metadata.
maya_cs: Great — once I have the checklist filled I'll post a short status update here. Summary of owners/action items: Alex (sales) -> get SAML/KMS/VPC contacts and SOW (in progress); Maya (CS) -> onboarding checklist + kickoff (owner); Lin (Eng) -> private-eval + sizing (owner); Dan (Support) -> runbook + PD schedule (owner); Jen (Ops) -> billing/contract confirmation. Target: private eval up in 7 business days after metadata received, enablement within 2 days of spin-up. :white_check_mark:
alex_sales: Thanks team — tagging Priya in the kickoff invite now. I'll update thread when I have their metadata. :thumbsup:
maya_cs: 👍 closing loop for now — will post follow-ups and the checklist here.
